integrity: The general expected-progress factor and the one-step unrelaxed projection already follow from the motivating source; novelty is limited to the sharp M-dependent bound, its nonattained sharpness, exact hit-time contrast, and normalization distinction. Proof is analytical, with finite checks only supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Consistent planar systems, pairwise full-rank two-row blocks and unit row norms only
Global precomputed normalization gives the sharp mean-square envelope; an online running maximum initialized at the first sampled pair is a separate algorithm
No claims about blocks smaller than dimension, noise, numerical roundoff, or generic faster/slower performance
title: Sharp redundancy penalty and online escape for volume-relaxed planar block projections
